name: Barfender: CO-OP Bar Simulator
summary: 1 至 4 人合作酒吧模拟，2026 年 10 月 12 日上市。开发者披露生成式 AI 只用于旁白/配音流程并征得配音演员同意，另外 Steam 胶囊宣传图用到 AI 生成内容；同时强调视觉素材与玩法内容全部由团队和外部美术制作。

reviewNote: 核查 Steam 英文商店页完整 AI 披露、身份（开发商 Proto Division，发行商 Rock Paper Publisher）与英文讨论区首页（可见 15 个主题，总数 112），首页没有与 AI 使用直接相关的主题，未逐帖展开。本款单独检索公开报道 1 次、登记 6 条结果，读取 1 篇原始来源（HowMuchAI 逐部件拆解本作披露的分析页，逐字复刻披露原文，不构成独立核实）。其余结果为本作商店页与 Instagram、TikTok、Facebook 的宣传短视频页，中转抓取只能拿到壳页。商店披露原文末尾带有一个多余的引号，本条按原文照录。领域判定全部来自商店披露原文，结论基于开发者自述，未经独立审计；美术领域的“未使用”只是自述，不等于独立核实。
disclosureQuote: Generative AI tools were used only in the narration / voice acting workflow, with consent from the voice artist. Also AI-generated content used for Steam capsules. All visual assets, gameplay content, and core creative work are created by our team and external artists."
disclosureQuoteNote: Steam 商店 AI 生成内容披露栏完整原文，2026-11-03 核查；可能随商店页更新。

english.summary: A chaotic one to four player co-op bar simulator released on Oct 12, 2026. The developer states that generative AI tools were used only in the narration and voice-acting workflow with the voice artist's consent and that AI-generated content was used for the Steam capsules, while all visual assets, gameplay content and core creative work came from the team and external artists.
english.reviewNote: Reviewed the full English Steam AI disclosure, the identity (developer Proto Division, publisher Rock Paper Publisher) and the English discussion homepage (15 visible topics of 112); no homepage topic directly concerns AI use and individual threads were not opened. This title was searched 1 time with 6 results and 1 raw source(s) were read; the HowMuchAI page reproduces the disclosure verbatim and breaks it down part by part, so it is a transcription rather than independent verification. The remaining results were the store page and promotional short-video pages on Instagram, TikTok and Facebook, where the relay only returned shell pages. The disclosure text ends with a stray closing quotation mark on the store page and is recorded here exactly as published. Every area finding comes from the store disclosure text itself and rests on the developer's own statement, without an independent audit. The art finding is the developer's own statement that visual assets were made by the team and external artists and was not independently verified.
